name: becise
description: Rebuild any chart from any source (slide, PDF, dashboard, screenshot) via the Becise MCP, show it live, and place it into Slides/Docs or export as PNG. Orchestrates slide-revision-v2: slide_analyze → ask what takeaway the audience should leave with (plain language) → slide_revision_critique (confirmedClaim and/or confirmedJob required) → consent on raw critique → slide_revision_build. No Drive/email search for enrichment. Bundles becise-chart, becise-place, becise-story-enrichment, and becise-slide-revision-v2.
